caption:
Rate first. Then the deal.

This is a concept project, not a real client. KURS is a made-up currency exchange in Munich, a brief I set myself: how can a money service look calm instead of loud?

— the mark: two arrows, one amount goes out, another comes back
— colours: ink, paper and one signal orange
— type: Onest for words, JetBrains Mono for currency codes and figures
— a Russian post for Telegram and a German A3 poster on the same grid

In Germany, exchanging cash currency needs a BaFin licence, so a real version would show it on every piece.

Selling something people must trust? Send me a DM.
